# Marine Cold Spell Events {#cold_spell}

**Description**: Surface and bottom marine cold spells (MCSs) for 2025.

**Found in**: State of the Ecosystem - Indicator Catalog (2026+), State of the Ecosystem - Mid-Atlantic (2026), State of the Ecosystem - New England (2026) 

**Indicator category**: Published methods; Database pull with analysis

**Contributor(s)**: Vincent Saba
  
**Data steward**: Vincent Saba <vincent.saba@noaa.gov>
  
**Point of contact**: Vincent Saba <vincent.saba@noaa.gov>
  
**Public availability statement**: Source data are publicly available.

## Methods

### Data sources

OISST, debiased ROMS BT, GLORYS BT 

### Data analysis

https://robwschlegel.github.io/heatwaveR/articles/detection_and_visualisation.html#calculating-marine-cold-spells-mcss

### Data processing 

Raw data were linearly detrended.
